title: Russian Orzo Pilaf with Crispy Nourishing Topping
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish with crispy topping, inspired by Russian cuisine. Perfect for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: nourishing
ingredients.amount: 1 cup (chopped vegetables: carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped nourishing ingredients and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add orzo and pilaf to the skillet, stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the orzo is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
While the pilaf cooks, heat a small amount of oil in a separate pan.
Add crushed crispy fried onions and cook until crispy and golden brown.
Fluff the cooked pilaf with a fork, then top with crispy onions.
